_readme: Copy to data/profile/profile.json (or edit in the web UI, Profile tab). Everything here is handed to Claude when it fills a form. Leave a value empty if you don't want it used. EEO fields accept a value or "decline".

work_authorization.sponsorship_answer_text: Yes. I am on F-1 and will need H-1B sponsorship in the future; I can start on OPT without sponsorship.

preferences.salary_expectation_text: Open to market rate for the role and location

eeo.veteran_status: I am not a protected veteran

rules_for_claude: Never click the final Submit / Send Application button. Stop on the review page.
Do not invent facts. If a required field cannot be answered from this profile, the resume, or the answer bank, stop and report it as an unanswered question.
Prefer 'decline to self-identify' for EEO questions marked decline.
If the site needs an account, create one with the profile email; report the password you generated in the summary.
If a CAPTCHA, phone verification or email code appears, stop and report it.
